tim_output.campaign_summary: Ghost (also known as Cring and other aliases) is a Chinese-based ransomware threat actor that has conducted indiscriminate attacks since early 2021 against organizations across more than 70 countries by exploiting unpatched vulnerabilities in internet-facing applications such as Fortinet FortiOS, Adobe ColdFusion, Microsoft SharePoint, and Microsoft Exchange. The actors rapidly move through compromised networks using Cobalt Strike Beacon, open-source privilege escalation tools, and credential dumping utilities, deploying ransomware variants (Cring.exe, Ghost.exe, ElysiumO.exe, Locker.exe) to encrypt entire systems or specific directories while threatening to sell exfiltrated data if ransoms are not paid. This campaign poses significant risk to critical infrastructure, healthcare, government, education, and commercial sectors.
